notes: Extracted 2026-10-15 from the official UGC PDF (6 PDF pages: page 1 chapter text, page 2 Table 7.1, pages 3-6 Table 7.2) using pdfplumber word coordinates; each number was assigned to its printed column by x-position, so blank cells are null and printed zeros are 0.

Checks passed: Table 7.1 male+female=total and total/enrolment reproduces the printed % on every row; the column sums of all rows equal the printed Total row. Table 7.2: on every row the year cells sum to the printed Total Mahapola/Bursary; faculty rows sum to each university Total row in every column; university and institution totals sum to the Grand Total in every column.

Table 7.1: Sripalee Campus, Trincomalee Campus and Swamy Vipulananda Institute are printed as separate rows and the column sums show they are NOT included in the University of Colombo / Eastern University rows.

Table 7.1: the single values for Sripalee Campus, Gampaha Wickramarachchi University of Indigenous Medicine and Swamy Vipulananda Institute of Aesthetic Studies sit in the Female column (Male printed blank, stored null).

Table 7.2: university names are printed as short rotated side labels (e.g. 'Colombo', 'Eastern'); the block order was confirmed from the label positions and the faculty names. 'Gampaha Wickramarachchi' is hyphenated across lines in print.

Table 7.2: the University of Colombo block includes a 'Sri Palee Campus' row (tagged letter S). The Eastern University block includes a 'Trincomalee Campus' heading row (printed totals 0 and 0) followed by Applied Sciences, Communication and Business Studies and Siddha Medicine Unit; those three rows are tagged campus 'Trincomalee Campus' / letter W by layout inference. University Total rows include these campus rows.

Table 7.2: the header marks 'Mahapola (2)' but the text of note (2) is not printed anywhere in this chapter; only note (1) appears, and its marker sits next to the University of Sri Jayewardenepura 'Applied Science' row.
Spellings kept exactly as printed: 'RECEIPIENTS', 'Physiotheraphy', 'Transalation', 'University of Vavuniya,Sri Lanka'.
Monthly Mahapola scholarship and Bursary amounts are NOT printed in this chapter.

Not mapped to a ZedPath letter (absent from data/ugc/2025-2026/unicodes.csv): 'Institute for Agro Technology and Rural Sciences' (Table 7.1) and 'Institute of Technology University of Moratuwa' (Tables 7.1 and 7.2). Swamy Vipulananda Institute mapped to Y and University of Colombo School of Computing to T, per unicodes.csv.
